name: dsh-embedded-browser
description: A browser that lives inside the DSH host: every session gets its own tab, the AI drives it with lazily published browser_embedded_* tools, and a human watches or takes over that same tab in an on-demand right-Sidebar tab — no GUI, no external browser, logins/2FA/QR codes/CAPTCHAs included.

scripts.test: node test/lazy-gate.mjs && node test/diagnostics.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/tabs.mjs
scripts.test:full: node test/lazy-gate.mjs && node test/diagnostics.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/tabs.mjs && node test/stress-suite.mjs && node test/keepalive-idle.mjs
